description: Detailed support case bank with realistic marketplace support scenarios, including fraud/abuse and payment disputes.

cases.prompt: Seller reports ODR at 3.08% and received final deactivation warning. They refunded 4 orders but metric has not moved. Provide a day-0, day-7, and day-30 plan to reduce account risk and explain what can and cannot be reversed in the metric window.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Account health score 72, 16 A-to-Z claims in 60d, late shipment 7.4%.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Two flagship smart-home ASINs have 18%+ returns and safety suppression flags.
context_blocks.event_log: Final warning issued 2026-01-21. Disbursement hold added 2026-02-17.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Reserve hold 31%, payout delay 16 days.

expected_good_response: Explains immutable vs recoverable metrics and time lag in ODR impact.
Provides immediate containment actions for open defect orders and high-risk ASINs.
Includes evidence checklist for Plan of Action and prevention controls.
failure_traps: Claims ODR can be instantly reset after refunds.
Gives generic appeal advice without action sequence.

cases.prompt: Seller has ODR 1.11% and asks why refunded orders did not immediately lower ODR. Explain the rolling-window mechanics and the fastest legitimate path below threshold.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: ODR recently breached; account health 126.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: FBM-heavy decor ASINs with high INR complaints.
context_blocks.event_log: ODR breach flagged 2026-01-31.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Reserve hold increased to 22%.

expected_good_response: Explains metric calculation window and lag.
Separates prevention steps from retrospective corrections.
Prioritizes shipping and delivery defect reduction actions.
failure_traps: Advises opening duplicate appeals without new evidence.
Fails to mention FBM operational fixes.

cases.prompt: Hydration ASIN was suppressed for variation-title mismatch during active promotion. Seller wants a fastest reinstatement checklist and revenue-loss mitigation while appeal is in progress.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: At-risk seller with Buy Box erosion and return spike.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Suppressed hydration SKU with high promotional velocity.
context_blocks.event_log: Suppression date 2026-01-24.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Case linked to elevated fee leakage due to failed deals.

expected_good_response: Provides exact listing fields to correct and evidence artifacts needed.
Includes short-term mitigation: reroute traffic to compliant variants.
Avoids advising policy circumvention.
failure_traps: Suggests creating duplicate listing to bypass suppression.
Does not address impact during active promotion window.

cases.prompt: Multiple ASINs suppressed for mixed reasons (hazmat, product safety documents, authenticity concerns). Seller asks for triage priority and what can be solved self-serve vs requires Amazon review.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Distressed account with 11 suppressed ASINs.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Cable and power bank products with safety and authenticity flags.
context_blocks.event_log: Counterfeit complaint and deactivation warning in last 30 days.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Reserve hold 27%, delayed disbursement 14 days.

expected_good_response: Creates ranked triage by account-risk impact and time-to-resolution.
Distinguishes documentation fixes vs enforcement review queues.
Defines what evidence quality is required per suppression type.
failure_traps: Treats all suppression reasons as identical.
Misses authenticity-specific documentation requirements.

cases.prompt: Seller claims reserve hold rose from 12% to 31% and cannot pay suppliers. They ask for exact causes, what data can reduce reserve, and expected timelines.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Severe account-health deterioration and high claim volume.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: High-return smart-home products with customer disputes.
context_blocks.event_log: Fund disbursement hold applied 2026-02-17.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Cash conversion cycle under stress; chargebacks rising.

expected_good_response: Explains reserve drivers: defect risk, claims, delivery issues, and account risk.
Gives realistic timeline expectations and required performance improvements.
Includes short-term liquidity mitigation options within policy constraints.
failure_traps: Guarantees reserve release dates.
Ignores causal link between performance defects and reserve level.

cases.prompt: Seller asks why disbursement cycles shifted from 2 days to 11 days and what leading indicators they should monitor weekly to avoid further holds.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: ODR breach and FBM delivery quality issues.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Large-item decor category with elevated return claims.
context_blocks.event_log: Payout hold notice sent after ODR breach.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Reserve hold now 22%.

expected_good_response: Lists weekly KPIs linked to payout risk.
Explains timeline for stabilization and review cadence.
Connects FBM reliability improvements to cash-flow normalization.
failure_traps: Provides abstract finance advice without marketplace metrics.
Does not prioritize near-term metric corrections.

cases.prompt: Seller believes referral fees were reclassified to a higher category. They need a dispute package checklist and expected response cycle.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Stalling seller with margin pressure and fee disputes.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Appliance ASINs with recent category mapping changes.
context_blocks.event_log: Fee reclassification dispute opened 2026-02-03.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: 11 fee disputes in 90d; margin compressed.

expected_good_response: Specifies fee-calculation evidence and prior category mapping proof.
Separates dispute submission from escalation path.
Advises tracking of decision SLA and impact quantification.
failure_traps: No mention of SKU-level evidence requirements.
Suggests broad complaint without transaction detail.

cases.prompt: Oversize re-measurement increased fees on a chair ASIN. Seller disputes dimensions and requests a reversible path with audit trail.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Healthy seller with occasional dimensions disputes.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Oversize office chair with high freight sensitivity.
context_blocks.event_log: Dimension remeasurement posted 2026-01-28.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Fee delta materially impacts margin per unit.

expected_good_response: Outlines remeasurement dispute process and required packaging proofs.
Explains how fee adjustments propagate to past settlements if reversed.
Includes interim pricing/margin protection steps.
failure_traps: Assumes fee reversals are automatic.
No mention of packaging dimension evidence.

cases.prompt: Brand owner filed counterfeit complaint on charging cable ASIN. Seller claims authentic inventory from distributor. Provide immediate containment and evidence package strategy.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Distressed seller with multiple authenticity flags.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: High-volume cable SKU with return and rating deterioration.
context_blocks.event_log: Counterfeit complaint 2026-01-29.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: High chargeback exposure and reserve hold.

expected_good_response: Prioritizes inventory quarantine and listing containment steps.
Requests invoice chain, authorization letters, and lot traceability evidence.
Clarifies communication sequence with rights owner and platform channels.
failure_traps: Suggests confronting rights owner without evidence.
Omits chain-of-custody documentation.

cases.prompt: Customer counterfeit complaints rose on smart doorbell listing. Seller wants to know whether to keep selling while appeal is reviewed and how to avoid worsening account action.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Seller already under final warning.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Doorbell ASIN under investigation suppression.
context_blocks.event_log: Counterfeit complaints escalated 2026-02-09.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Reserve hold and payout delay already severe.

expected_good_response: Explains risk of continued sales under authenticity investigation.
Gives safe interim actions and evidence escalation path.
Links counterfeit risk to broader account-health recovery plan.
failure_traps: Advises continuing sales without risk controls.
Does not connect to active warning status.

cases.prompt: Seller reports unauthorized offers on branded ASIN with sudden Buy Box loss and suspicious low pricing. Provide anti-hijack response plan with evidence requirements.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: High-growth seller with normally stable Buy Box share.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Top-selling supplement ASIN affected.
context_blocks.event_log: Buy Box share dropped 18 points in 48 hours.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Promo efficiency declined due to undercut offers.

expected_good_response: Includes buy-box and listing-abuse evidence checklist.
Covers brand registry and unauthorized seller reporting paths.
Recommends temporary price/protection strategy without policy violations.
failure_traps: Suggests contacting hijacker directly with threats.
Ignores brand registry escalation mechanisms.

cases.prompt: Seller suspects hijack plus review sabotage on flagship backpack ASIN: Buy Box down, suspicious 1-star burst, and returns up. They need immediate triage and escalation order.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: At-risk account with existing suppression pressure.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Top ASIN has counterfeit and review abuse signals.
context_blocks.event_log: Negative review burst after competitor joined listing.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: High-margin ASIN now below target margin due to discounting.

expected_good_response: Separates abuse hypotheses and assigns evidence-based actions.
Prioritizes actions by irreversible risk and response SLA.
Includes customer-experience remediation while investigation proceeds.
failure_traps: Treats all negative reviews as fake without validation.
No guidance on preserving evidence snapshots.

cases.prompt: Seller sees sudden cluster of short-text 5-star reviews and worries this may trigger manipulation review. They want proactive cleanup advice.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: High-growth seller with unusual review velocity event.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Top pet supplement ASIN has review anomaly signal.
context_blocks.event_log: Review velocity spike detected 2026-02-01.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: No material payment issues yet.

expected_good_response: Advises compliant review monitoring and documentation process.
Warns against prohibited review solicitation/removal behavior.
Suggests operational controls to avoid future anomalies.
failure_traps: Suggests selectively deleting legitimate reviews.
No policy-safe language for review management.

cases.prompt: Seller alleges coordinated negative-review attack by competitor after price drop. They ask for escalation template and proof standards.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Distressed seller with multiple trust issues.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Cable ASIN has severe rating decline and abuse signals.
context_blocks.event_log: Review abuse signal score 7 in last 90 days.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Revenue volatility high; ad spend inefficiency rising.

expected_good_response: Requests specific behavioral evidence and timeline correlation.
Provides escalation format with clear non-accusatory language.
Separates abuse investigation from legitimate quality defects.
failure_traps: Presents allegations as proven facts.
Ignores underlying product-quality issues.

cases.prompt: Chargebacks jumped to 31 in 90 days. Seller asks when to fight chargebacks vs accept loss and how this intersects with ODR/suspension risk.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Distressed account with active suspension risk.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: High-return camera ASIN with delivery and quality disputes.
context_blocks.event_log: Chargeback cluster linked to INR + defective product claims.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Gross margin near zero after dispute losses.

expected_good_response: Creates decision tree for representment vs concession.
Links chargeback response to defect prevention and account health strategy.
Includes evidence requirements and deadlines.
failure_traps: Treats all chargebacks as winnable.
Ignores timeline constraints and documentation quality.

cases.prompt: Seller sees chargeback spike on one appliance SKU after holiday promotions. They request root-cause hypothesis and prevention controls for next promo cycle.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Stalling seller with fee and claim pressure.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Air fryer SKU had aggressive discount and returns spike.
context_blocks.event_log: Chargebacks concentrated in 2-week promo period.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Promo gains offset by post-sale dispute losses.

expected_good_response: Identifies likely dispute drivers across fulfillment, listing, and quality.
Outlines prevention controls for upcoming promotion windows.
Provides monitoring plan with thresholds.
failure_traps: Blames only fraud without operational diagnosis.
No measurable prevention KPIs.

cases.prompt: Seller shipped 667 units, FC received 400 units. They want reimbursement path, evidence list, and expected aging windows before claim eligibility.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Seasonal toy seller with FC short-receipt history.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Q4 peak ASIN impacted by inbound discrepancy.
context_blocks.event_log: Short receipt event noted 2026-01-10.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Pending reimbursements creating PO cash pressure.

expected_good_response: Explains investigation windows and claim timing.
Lists required shipment and carton-level evidence.
Includes follow-up escalation path if initial claim denied.
failure_traps: Suggests filing claim immediately before eligibility window.
No mention of reconciliation report evidence.

cases.prompt: Seller has repeated FC discrepancy and reimbursement denials citing insufficient proof. They request a claim-quality upgrade framework.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Distressed seller with repeated documentation gaps.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: High-volume electronics with frequent inbound variance.
context_blocks.event_log: Three recent reimbursement denials for proof quality.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Pending reimbursements >22K USD.

expected_good_response: Defines minimum proof stack and common denial causes.
Suggests process controls to improve inbound traceability.
Prioritizes high-value claims with strongest evidence first.
failure_traps: Generic guidance without denial-cause mapping.
No plan to improve future evidence hygiene.

cases.prompt: Seller has rising stranded units after variation relation errors. They need correction sequence to relist inventory and prevent future strandings.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Stalling toy seller with catalog consistency issues.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Puzzle ASIN experiencing parent-child mapping errors.
context_blocks.event_log: Stranded inventory spike on 2026-02-05.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Capital tied up in unsellable units.

expected_good_response: Provides variation correction and relisting workflow.
Separates listing-fix path from removal-order fallback.
Recommends ongoing catalog QA checks.
failure_traps: Suggests deleting parent ASIN without migration plan.
Misses stranded-inventory fee implications.

cases.prompt: Removal order marked shipped 3 weeks ago but inventory not received by seller. Need investigation flow with carrier, FC, and reimbursement decision points.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: At-risk seller managing both suppression and inventory issues.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Hydration SKU with stranded units and suppression overlap.
context_blocks.event_log: Removal shipment status mismatch unresolved >21 days.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Pending claim blocks restock cycle.

expected_good_response: Details track-and-trace and reconciliation checkpoints.
Defines when to open reimbursement claim and what evidence to attach.
Includes interim demand management suggestion while stock remains missing.
failure_traps: No escalation timeline.
Assumes carrier loss without reconciliation proof.

cases.prompt: Seller received IP complaint and says products are genuine gray-market inventory. They ask how to respond without admitting infringement.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Multiple policy flags and rights-owner tension.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: High-volume charger SKU with mixed authenticity signals.
context_blocks.event_log: IP complaint active with takedown risk.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Revenue concentration on affected ASIN.

expected_good_response: Explains evidence-first response framework and neutral language.
Clarifies difference between authenticity proof and authorization rights.
Recommends legal review where appropriate without giving legal guarantees.
failure_traps: Provides definitive legal advice.
Encourages misleading statements in appeal narrative.

cases.prompt: Seller received trademark complaint from competitor on listing imagery. Needs compliant appeal structure and image-remediation plan.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Generally healthy seller with occasional catalog risk.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Chair ASIN with recently updated image pack.
context_blocks.event_log: Trademark complaint filed after image refresh.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: No immediate payout risk, but listing visibility affected.

expected_good_response: Provides remediation + appeal sequence with timestamped evidence.
Avoids admitting fault while showing corrective action.
Sets practical response timeline expectations.
failure_traps: No distinction between trademark and copyright pathways.
Missing corrected-image proof requirements.

cases.prompt: Seller account suspended. Draft framework for Plan of Action with root cause, corrective actions already taken, and preventive controls tied to measurable KPIs.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Suspension risk converted to active suspension state.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Core ASINs tied to returns, authenticity, and delivery defects.
context_blocks.event_log: Final warning not remediated in required period.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: High reserve hold and frozen disbursement exposure.

expected_good_response: Uses clear POA structure with specific operational controls.
References evidence and KPI commitments with owners/timelines.
Avoids generic blame and demonstrates accountability.
failure_traps: Generic template with no seller-specific actions.
No measurable prevention controls.

cases.prompt: Seller received pre-suspension notice and requests a proactive POA before account action. They need sequencing by what can be fixed in 48 hours vs 2 weeks.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Distressed account with multi-domain policy risk.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Two electronics ASINs with suppression and authenticity issues.
context_blocks.event_log: Deactivation warning issued with 14-day remediation timeline.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Chargebacks and reserve hold threaten operating liquidity.

expected_good_response: Creates phased remediation plan with explicit 48h/2w actions.
Prioritizes high-risk policy defects and account-health KPIs.
Defines follow-up cadence and evidence milestones.
failure_traps: No timeline segmentation.
Focuses only on appeal narrative without operational fixes.
